digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (src/rebar/*.py, attest/, metrics/, review_bot/, opcert_service/, audit/, grounding/, _guides/)
propositions: Comment triage across root modules and services (180 lines in 7,248) identified four verified-stale comments that required in-place correction: review_bot shutdown wording and SEVERITIES blocking-subset notes that no longer reflect current behavior.

Three multi-line inline rationale blocks in review_bot (shutdown drain/cancel logic, in-flight counter over-count, retryable coverage-gap deferral) were relocated to dedicated ADRs (0067/0068/0069) and replaced with one-line citations, yielding net-near-zero comment change through refactoring.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that serve as sole documentation for keys absent from docs/config.md (completion_floor_active, comment_max_chars, auth_proxy_secret_env, etc.); recovery beyond ~34 trivial lines requires writing docs/config.md rows first to avoid documentation loss.
MCP schema-assurance comment at _mcp_models.py:31-34 was already accurate on main (BridgeFsckOut declares binding_drift, CI gate test_mcp_model_schema_drift_* exists); no re-correction needed.

DO_NOT_MOVE ledger confirmed: _mcp_llm.py tool docstrings (~121 lines) are wire-visible FastMCP API surface; _config_schema.py read-via: markers (12 instances) are CI-consumed by scripts/check_config_reads.py — both must remain verbatim.
All test suites and linting gates (pytest, ruff, mypy, config-read gate) passed unchanged post-merge; no runtime behavior modified — change is text-only (comments, docstrings, docs, ADRs).
